mapper.select: SELECT tm.* FROM generation_task_material tm JOIN generation_task t ON t.id=tm.task_id JOIN material m ON m.id=tm.material_id AND m.user_id=t.user_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND tm.task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY tm.task_id,tm.slot_index
